summary: This bill amends the Immigration and Nationality Act to classify voting in a federal election by an unlawfully present alien as an aggravated felony and a deportable offense.

scores.thoughts: This bill directly amends the Immigration and Nationality Act to make voting in a federal election by an unlawfully present alien an aggravated felony and a deportable offense. This strengthens enforcement against undocumented immigrants, aligning with the 'Secure Borders' end of the spectrum.
